claim: Says whether a broken shot stops the film or quietly becomes part of it. retry absorbs transient VRAM and network flakes; halt is for a final where a silent hole is unacceptable; warn_continue and placeholder are for overnight drafts, where waking to a watchable cut with gaps beats waking to a render that died at shot four.
not_visual: A failure-handling policy that only manifests when generation actually fails. On a successful render all four values produce the same frame; the difference lives in the log and in whether the finished film has a hole in it. It cannot be provoked by a prompt clause, and staging a fake failure would be demonstrating the placeholder variable instead of this one.
